tests.name: json_view_dump_indented
tests.intent: Verify basic indented dump output from json_view using the fast writer path.

tests.name: json_view_dump_ensure_ascii_indented
tests.intent: Verify indented dump output with ensure_ascii enabled on json_view.

tests.name: json_view_dump_compact_ensure_ascii
tests.intent: Verify compact dump output with ensure_ascii enabled on json_view.

tests.name: json_view_dump_damaged_image_indented_throw
tests.intent: Verify that an indented dump of a damaged image containing invalid UTF-8 throws type_error.316.

tests.name: json_view_editable_dump_pretty
tests.intent: Verify indented dumping on an editable json view document.

tests.name: json_view_deep_nesting_indented_dump
tests.intent: Verify deep nested container indentation with the fast writer line-break mechanism.

tests.name: json_view_ascii_copyable_run_edge_cases
tests.intent: Verify ASCII copying and escape sequences on strings around 16-byte alignment boundaries.

tests.name: json_view_plain_output_run_special_chars
tests.intent: Verify plain_output_run handles quotes, backslashes, and control codes correctly via SIMD/scalar paths.

tests.name: json_view_dump_custom_indent_char
tests.intent: Verify indented dumps with a custom indentation character.

tests.name: json_view_dump_unicode_multibyte_ascii
tests.intent: Verify ensure_ascii encoding of 2-byte, 3-byte and surrogate pair UTF-8 sequences.

tests.name: json_view_dump_empty_containers
tests.intent: Verify dump formatting for empty objects and arrays in both compact and indented modes.

tests.name: json_view_dump_source_numbers_flag
tests.intent: Verify that source_numbers flag behaves correctly during indented and compact views dumping.

tests.name: json_view_dump_large_integer_array
tests.intent: Verify fast writer efficiency and output correctness on large arrays of integers.

tests.name: json_view_dump_unicode_escapes_indented
tests.intent: Verify that escape sequences in source strings are processed properly with indented ensure_ascii dumping.

tests.name: json_view_dump_wide_indentation_ruler
tests.intent: Verify line break ruler handling when indentation level exceeds the 64-byte threshold.

tests.name: json_view_dump_mixed_types_object
tests.intent: Verify indented dump containing mixed types: booleans, null, numbers, strings, and arrays.

tests.name: json_view_dump_ascii_control_chars
tests.intent: Verify ensure_ascii correctly formats ASCII control characters as \u00XX.

tests.name: json_view_editable_view_dump_ascii
tests.intent: Verify editable json view dumps with ensure_ascii and indentation.

tests.name: json_view_dump_multiple_root_calls
tests.intent: Verify multiple consecutive calls to dump() with different styles on the same json_view instance.

tests.name: json_view_dump_scalar_roots
tests.intent: Verify dump behavior when the json_view points to a top-level scalar value (string, number, boolean, null).

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Test indented dump with ensure_ascii containing surrogate pairs for codepoints above U+FFFF, escaping characters, backspace, formfeed, carriage return, and non-copyable prefixes.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Test indented dump with source_numbers enabled and pretty-printing combined with ensure_ascii to exercise template branches like dump_text<true, true, true> and depth_counter.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Test indented dump with deep nesting where the required indentation line length exceeds 64 bytes, exercising the memset fallback path in newline().

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Test indented dump with decoded/edited strings that contain valid and invalid UTF-8 sequences when validate is true, verifying write_decoded validation paths.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Test indented dump without ensure_ascii on an editable view with source_numbers and custom formatting options to invoke dump_text<true, true, false> and un-run paths.

tests.intent: Verify that an indented dump of a damaged image containing invalid UTF-8 throws type_error.316.
